name: Nestlé USA Distribution Center - McDonough GA

fieldNotes.locationResolution: Roster coords (33.40872,-84.15465) and search-derived coords (33.40806,-84.15425) point at the same large NW-SE-oriented warehouse off Nestle Ct. Confirmed via Waze/Yelp/Henry County directory as the Nestlé Distribution Center, 1 Nestle Ct, McDonough GA 30253. Locked center 33.4084,-84.1543.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Web research describing the site's gate-guard duties confirms a controlled gated entry: the guard 'opens the gate to release the driver'. The compound is fully fenced (chain-link fencing visible in Street View of the access-road corridor).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Confirmed by web research: a gate guard works a window ('drivers bring license and bills to the window'), answers a call box, and issues yard passes. A staffed booth/window is present. The booth itself was not isolable from satellite (small ancillary structures on the NE access road), but the operational description is explicit.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - the gate is staffed by a guard, not a kiosk-only setup.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Web research describes a multi-stage check-in: gate guard verifies appointment/paperwork, checks trailer fuel/seals, then issues a yard pass with door numbers before releasing the driver into the yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Very large DC. SW long face carries an extended continuous dock run (~50-60 doors with trailers backed in); SE face carries another large bank (~30-40); plus docks on the NE side. Total well into the 50+ band; ~110 is a rough overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard at the SE end - 4-5 rows of ~25-30 trailers each (well over 100 dropped trailers), plus marked trailer stalls along the NE side. Clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~175 trailers counted across dock faces and the SE drop yard in the captured imagery; approximate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on physically separate building faces (long SW face and SE face) consistent with separate shipping/receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur runs directly alongside the NE face of the building into the property - the facility is rail-served.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Large open paved yard inside the gate and a wide access corridor provide ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The gate-to-dock approach crosses a large interior yard that easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard inside the gate (where drivers receive their yard pass) before reaching the dock faces.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility sits in a freeway-side industrial/logistics park on the edge of McDonough (a small Georgia city), surrounded by warehouses and woodland rather than dense metro fabric; classified Rural per the rubric's small-town-industrial guidance.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC warehouse plus one small ancillary structure (blue-roofed building near the rail spur on the NE side).
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible in the imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single combined entry/exit at the one gate; exit lane count inferred as 1.

citations.claim: Nestlé USA states the McDonough GA facility is fully operational
Active RD petition (Jan 2024) for the Nestlé USA McDonough GA distribution-center bargaining unit; confirms ongoing operation with employees on site

verification.rationale: Nestlé USA's own page states the McDonough DC is fully operational; RWDSU-represented workforce with active 2024 NLRB proceedings.
